headline: The flagship commuting order-(3,2) holonomy pair has an exact physical inner lift to all of E8 through SU(9). The full 248-dimensional joint multiplicities are (0,+)=44,(0,-)=48,(1,+)=38,(1,-)=40,(2,+)=38,(2,-)=40. Fixed algebras: D7+u1 (92), D8 (120), and D4+A3+u1 (44) for the order-3, order-2, and order-6 elements respectively.
resolution: Physical parity is an inner torus/Chevalley automorphism, not a Coxeter root permutation; this resolves the 40-vs-36 firewall without identifying the two operations.
